description: Reconciles governed record-level source releases into canonical business entities, assertions, relationships, and ZIP coverage without overstating completeness.
retry: Rerun from immutable source pointers; no external requests or partial retry side effects occur.
checkpoint: Inputs and outputs are checksummed; publication uses a run-scoped staging directory and atomic current pointer.
idempotency: Entity IDs derive from source candidates and assertion/relationship IDs are deterministic hashes of source-backed facts.
cancellation: Stop streaming at the current record; no current pointer is changed until the complete release is published.
source_policy: Inherited per assertion from each contributing source policy; current releases use USDA SNAP and CMS NPPES public normalized policies.
retention_profile: Retain immutable public registry releases until an approved retention operation removes them.
